name: kn-social-security-contributions
description: Saint Kitts and Nevis social security contribution reference checked for 2026. Covers the ordinary employee and employer shares, monthly insurable earnings ceiling, pay classifications, age-transition weeks and monthly reporting. Uses the official revised Social Security Act and contribution regulations together with the Board’s administrative guidance. Includes worked monthly calculations and distinguishes social insurance from the uncapped housing levy and severance contribution. Use after covered employment and the relevant payroll period have been established. A complete post-revision amendment audit and independent accountant review remain outstanding. This draft does not determine benefit entitlement or self-employed assessments.
